source.prompt: Instrumental ambient meditation music, very slow and calm, no drums, no vocals. Warm, dark, soft synth pads that swell gently, with sparse low piano notes from a pentatonic scale every few seconds, deep reverb, no bright high frequencies. Gentle fade in, stays still and floating, long fade out at the end.

Instrumental meditation music, very slow and calm, no drums, no vocals. A solo soft felt piano playing sparse, gentle notes and open chords from a pentatonic scale, long sustain, deep warm reverb, lots of space and silence between phrases, dark and intimate tone, no bright high frequencies. Gentle fade in, long fade out at the end.

Instrumental meditation music, very slow and calm, no drums, no vocals. Tibetan singing bowls struck softly every few seconds and left to ring out, layered over a low, warm overtone drone with gently shimmering harmonics, pentatonic tones, deep reverb, dark and grounding, no bright high frequencies. Gentle fade in, long fade out at the end. Begins softly from silence.

Instrumental meditation music, very slow and calm, no drums, no vocals. A soft, breathy bamboo flute playing slow pentatonic phrases with long pauses, gentle harp notes underneath, over a warm low sustained pad, deep reverb, dark and peaceful, no bright high frequencies. Gentle fade in, long fade out at the end.
